value.title: Run, Strongest Team! Toriko, Luffy, and Goku!
value.synopsis: Toriko's team and the Strawhat Crew of One Piece meet again, only this time they also meet Goku and the Dragonball Z Fighters!

value.title: Commemorating the Hundredth Episode, All Four Heavenly Kings Assemble!
Toriko Fainting in Agony?! Capture the World's Smelliest Ingredient!
Too Huge! With Pro Wrestling Moves, the Completion of the Ehou Maki!!
Hands Together and Bow! Gourmet Human National Treasure Chin Chinchin Appears!
Those Without Gratitude Should Not Enter! The Fearsome Shokurin Temple!!
value.synopsis: The legendary Chourin Temple holds the ingredient sought by Toriko and Komatsu, but the adventurous eaters might not be ready for the teachings of the temple's Master!

value.title: Toriko, Completely Defeated?! The Delicate and Uninhibited Power of Food Honor!!
value.synopsis: Toriko's quest to attain the elusive Bubble Fruit hits a snag when he must fight a surprisingly formidable foe. If the gourmet hunter wants to complete his quest, he must learn to honor the food!

value.title: It's All About Appreciation! The Essentials of Food Honor!!
value.synopsis: Before they can truly honor the food, Toriko and Komatsu must master the art of gratitude by completing a series of tasks that prove far more difficult than originally expected!

value.title: An Approaching Threat! Hurry, Toriko! The Road to the Bubble Fruits!
value.synopsis: His training complete, Toriko embarks on a lengthy journey to capture the Bubble Fruit! Meanwhile, back at Chowlin Temple, something evil approaches!

value.title: Tragedy!! The Demise of Shokurin Temple... Farewell, Komatsu!!
value.synopsis: Toriko pushes himself to the breaking point on his hunt for the Bubble Fruit, and a Bishokukai raiding party wreaks havoc at Chowlin Temple!

value.title: Mighty and Unrivaled! One Who Has Mastered Food Honor!
value.synopsis: Toriko uses his new technique - and the strength he gained by eating the Bubble Fruit - to easily destroy a giant green monster, but the Master of Chowlin Temple may not be so lucky!

value.title: 'National Treasure Class' One-Swing 100 Million Yen Techniques! Toriko VS Granny Chiyo
value.synopsis: Toriko shows off an awesome array of powerful new techniques in his battle with Granny Chiyo, but the arrival of a mysterious and terrifying GT Robot puts their bout on hold!

value.title: The Phantasmal Ingredient 'Center' Ichiryuu and the Mighty 0th Biotope
value.synopsis: An unexpected visitor uses a dangerous technique in an attempt to heal Master Chin-Chin, and the strongest warriors from the IGO gather for dinner - and to prepare for war!

value.title: The Legendary Bee, the 'infini Bee' Toriko VS the New Model GT Robo
value.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu are sent to search for Golden Wheat, but their mission is interrupted by the arrival of a terrifying and powerful new GT Robo!

value.title: Showing His True Strength! Komatsu's Food Honor The Actual Food! The Phantasmal Noodles, 'Zenmen'
value.synopsis: Toriko shocks the GT Robo with his amazing strength, and Komatsu gets an assignment from Granny Setsu that will put his powers of Honoring the Food to the ultimate test!

value.title: The Four Heavenly Kings Gather! The Gourmet World Beasts the 'Four Beasts' Awaken!
value.synopsis: The Four Heavenly Kings share a mega meal together, Komatsu learns the secret to preparing Bubble Fruit, and the human world braces for the arrival of the Four-Beasts!

value.title: The Battle to Determine the Fate of Mankind!! The Four Beasts VS the Four Heavenly Kings!!
value.synopsis: Humanity watches in horror as the Four-Beasts easily destroy the military's strongest weapons, but all hope is not lost - the Heavenly Kings are about to join the fight!

value.title: Toriko, Coco, Sani, Zebra The Four Heavenly Kings' Storm of Attacks!!
value.synopsis: The Four Heavenly Kings use every attack in their arsenal to survive their battle with the Four-Beasts, but there's a surprise in store for our heroes that could prove fatal!

value.title: Toriko's New Crisis The Creeping Four Beast's Main Body!
value.synopsis: Toriko, Coco, Sunny, and Zebra appear to have the upper hand in their battle with the Four-Beasts, but the monster's main body is about to wreak havoc on civilization!

value.title: The Four Beast's Shocking Union and the Green Rain!!
value.synopsis: While Toriko, Coco, Sunny, and Zebra battle the monstrous Four-Beasts, Komatsu rushes to make an edible antidote to the toxic Green Rain that's drenching the city!

value.title: The Four Heavenly Kings' Worst Dilemma! Komatsu's Determination!
value.synopsis: The Four Kings' battle against the Four-Beasts proves tougher than expected, and Komatsu tries desperately to speed up the process of making medicinal munchies!

value.title: Save Mankind with your Miraculous Food Luck!!
value.synopsis: Komatsu makes great progress in his quest to create a delicious remedy for the Green Rain, but the Four Kings find their attacks failing and their strength fading in their battle against the Four-Beasts!

value.title: Explode! Curiosity for Taste! The Four Heavenly King's Combination Technique!!
value.synopsis: The Four Kings hover on the verge of death until they recall a powerful technique from their training days - turning appetite into punching power!

value.title: Ultimate Technique 'Dinner of the Kings'
value.synopsis: Teppei tracks down a mysterious stranger who may be responsible for the rampaging beast, and the Four Kings look to end the battle with their ultimate technique!

value.title: The Forthcoming Festival The Wriggling 'Dangerous Guys'
value.synopsis: Teppei tries to remember the events that left him seriously injured, and Komatsu is honored by an invitation to participate in a world famous cooking festival!

value.title: Toriko VS the Gourmet World Monster 'Mon Planc'
value.synopsis: Toriko battles a Plant Beast from the Gourmet World, Komatsu worries about his performance in a famous cooking festival, and CoCo gambles for information!

value.title: Toriko's New Technique 'Nail Gun'!!
value.synopsis: Toriko must come up with some new moves to defeat the Mon Plan, Komatsu worries about the upcoming cooking festival, and Zebra returns to the home of Mellow Cola!

value.title: Great Imminent Troubles!? Cooking Fest Opens!!
value.synopsis: Audiences applaud wildly as Komatsu and the Four Kings arrive at the legendary Cooking Fest, but somewhere deep in the darkness, a powerful evil prepares to attack!

value.title: Komatsu in Trouble?! Triathlon Cooking!
value.synopsis: Komatsu is intimidated by the competition at the cooking festival, but he's got even bigger things to worry about: a grueling test of strength known as Triathlon Cooking!

value.title: The Legendary Chef Tengu Branchi Appears!!
value.synopsis: Komatsu falls far behind the field in the prestigious cooking festival, but when a top-ranked bad boy suddenly enters the competition, things could get even worse!

value.title: A Wild Ride of Super Foul Play! Branchi, Pulling Ahead!!
value.synopsis: Giraffe Birds and Sand Hamsters make their presence felt, Komatsu catches a lift with Brunch, and Triathlon Cooking kicks into high gear!

value.title: Live or Die? Death in the Balance Cooking!!
value.synopsis: Komatsu must reach the next round of the Cooking Fest without the help of his special Melk knife, but advancing could send the little chef headed toward a fiery fate!

value.title: Who are the Strongest Partners? Whole Island Cooking!
value.synopsis: Komatsu advances in the Cooking Fest, only to find out that his next challenge will be to cook an entire island! He recruits Toriko to help him out, but with the other Heavenly Kings cooking as well, the competition is anyone’s game.

value.title: The Outbreak of War! The Bishokukai.'s Fierce Full-scale Offensive!
value.synopsis: Komatsu's preparations for the next round of the Cooking Fest are interrupted by an old friend. Meanwhile, Toriko and the rest of the Four Kings brace for the arrival of evil!

value.title: Protect Komatsu! Toriko vs. Starjun!
value.synopsis: When Komatsu's life is threatened, Coco, Zebra, and Sunny spring into action to defend the little chef, but the main attraction is a brutal showdown between Toriko and Starjun!

value.title: Savage Battle! Toriko's Strongest Attack!
value.synopsis: Toriko pulls no punches in his slugfest with Starjun, Rin wages her own unique brand of war, and an army of chefs give the Gourmet Corp. more than they bargained for!

value.title: Top Showdown! IGO vs. Bishokukai
value.synopsis: The epic battle at Cooking Stadium rages on as Toriko and Starjun continue to throw down. If Toriko's going to be triumphant, he's can't pull any knife-and-fork punches.

value.title: The Terrible Trump Card! The Gourmet World Monsters, the 'Nitro'
value.synopsis: The IGO's chances for victory take a serious hit when the Gourmet Corp. unleashes the horrifying monsters Nitro and the Scum Beasts!

value.title: A Deadly Struggle! Coco VS Grinparch
value.synopsis: Thanks to Komatsu’s super culinary skills, Coco and Toriko have the strength to carry on their battles with two of the Gourmet Corp.’s most powerful monsters!

value.title: Duel! Sani VS Tommyrod
value.synopsis: Sunny puts his heroic hair to the ultimate test in a bombastic battle with Tommyrod and his grotesque army of deadly insects!

value.title: The End is Here! Sunny's Final Power!
value.synopsis: Sunny’s bloody battle with Tommyrod reaches its horrific end, and Brunch finds himself locked in an electrifying battle with an immortal warrior that cannot be destroyed!

value.title: Counterattack! Zebra Gets Moving!!
value.synopsis: Zebra evens the odds by unleashing the furious power of his voice, Setsuno tangles with an old rival, and Komatsu is shocked to find Toriko on the losing end of a battle!

value.title: Toriko's Counterattack! Ultimate Routine!!
value.synopsis: Komatsu’s heartbroken wailing helps revive a battered Toriko, who suddenly unleashes a devastating attack that harnesses the power of a great warrior’s imagination!

value.title: History's Greatest Enemy! 'Joa' Appears!!
value.synopsis: Toriko’s awesomely destructive battle with Starjun is interrupted by the arrival of Joie, an unbelievably deadly adversary who has the power to turn good into evil!

value.title: Shock! The True Identity of the Mastermind 'Joa'!!
value.synopsis: After the legendary Knocking Master Jiro unmasks the terrifying evil before them, his life is endangered by his affection for Granny Setsuno! Will Toriko arrive in time to save them both!?

value.title: The Beginning of the End! Toriko vs. Joa!!
value.synopsis: Toriko and Starjun forge an unlikely alliance to save Komatsu from a deadly adversary, and a riveting flashback reveals the tragic story of Froese the God Chef!

value.title: An Attack to Come Back from Hopelessness! The Four Heavenly Kings, the Ultimate Technique!!
value.synopsis: The Four Kings fight together against Joie, the strongest enemy they've ever faced and one who can't be eaten! Meanwhile, NEO gets ready to leave the chaos of the stadium and indeed the Human World behind them, but they also plan to take Komatsu with them, whether he's willing or not!

value.title: May Komatsu's Yells Reach Him! Toriko Awakens!!
value.synopsis: With the Four Kings utterly defeated, Joie is about to take Komatsu away, until Toriko tries one last, desperate gambit, which could make him lose control of himself and kill even his dearest friends! Meanwhile, the final battle between Ichiryu and Midora ends with a bang!

value.title: Toriko and Komatsu Departure for a New Journey!!
value.synopsis: The finale of the battle between Toriko and Joie! The Human World is devastated by a storm of mysterious meteorites! Amongst a backdrop of hope, forgiveness, and devious plans, Toriko and Komatsu embark on their greatest challenge: surviving a new world!
